name: Zealous cuts Radiance's cooldown by 30s and boosts its healing and damage by 125% (#1081)
contract: Zealous 560113 is family 33, Attributes 448 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE), EquippedItemClass -1, no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) and EffectSpellClassMask word1 65536 (0x10000), EffectBasePoints -30001 + DieSides 1 = -30000; Radiance's container spell 800054 (the one with its own RecoveryTime/CategoryRecoveryTime) carries that exact word1 bit. Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, ...) unconditionally whenever a matching spell is cast; spell_modifier exercises the same ApplySpellMod path synthetically with no cast. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) and EffectSpellClassMask word0 -2147483648 (bit 0x80000000), EffectBasePoints 124 + DieSides 1 = 125; Radiance's periodic payload 800038 (heal effect 0, damage effect 1) carries that exact word0 bit in SpellFamilyFlags_1. Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone and Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone both apply their own ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, ...) unconditionally at the end of each function, independent of any spell_bonus_data coefficient, so both the heal and the damage effect of 800038 gain the full 125%. None of this needs a script: this is not "no server-side implementation".

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Talent's Radiance cooldown drops by exactly 30s
